summary: Keep the experimental ContextLM embedding quantized

changes.title: Retain INT8 embedding bytes at runtime
changes.detail: The experimental ContextLM loader now retains its 1,048,576-byte embedding tensor in INT8 form and applies the manifest scale at bounded context and candidate lookups. This preserves the original float weight calculation while avoiding expansion to 4 MiB; the model remains disabled by default and fails production loading unless its independent quality gate passes.
